tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: List USDT perpetual contracts with price, 24h change, 24h volume and funding rate, sorted by volume, change or funding.

tools.name: coin_snapshot
tools.description: One contract now: mark price, funding rate and APR, next funding time, open interest and its 24h change, long/short account ratios, taker buy/sell ratio, max leverage.

tools.name: funding_history
tools.description: Funding rate history of one contract over up to 30 days, with latest, average, min, max and average APR.

tools.name: liquidation_map
tools.description: Estimated liquidation clusters above and below the current price for one contract: totals, the largest clusters and their price levels. Estimates, not actual orders.

tools.name: fear_greed_index
tools.description: Today's 0-100 crypto Fear & Greed reading built from futures data, with its four component scores.

tools.name: altcoin_season_index
tools.description: Share of the 100 most traded altcoins beating Bitcoin over 90 days (75+ altcoin season, 25 or less Bitcoin season).

tools.name: market_report_today
tools.description: Today's crypto futures market state (trend, volatility, liquidity, breadth, funding) from fixed numeric rules.

tools.name: liquidation_price
tools.description: Liquidation price of an isolated-margin futures position, using the contract's real maintenance-margin tiers. Give margin_usdt or quantity.

tools.name: position_size
tools.description: Position size from entry, stop and the USDT you are willing to lose, rounded to the contract's step, with margin, fees, loss at the stop and a warning if liquidation comes before the stop.

tools.name: preflight_link
tools.description: A link that opens SignalStates Pre-Flight with a planned trade filled in; it checks the stop against normal noise, liquidation, holding cost, crowding and size.
